The query lends one actual Go SSA tuple producer and ordinal. Primitive reuses its existing native instruction-membership and definition-order query; Go types owns tuple shape and element type identity. Witness owns errors.AsType predicate policy. Capabilities resolves GoToolchain ownership; no second registry is added.

Native fixtures cover every documented tuple producer family and lexical closures, checking all source-required ordinals and their independently authored types. Root and producer custody, missing/typed-nil/foreign/detached producers, definition order, type mismatch, ordinal boundaries, untaken absence, cancellation and causes are separate contracts. Producer and schema each have a local LayerTriad. The full byte semantic domain decomposes into two ordinals, four producer kinds, four custody/context states and eight prefix extents; no input bit is ignored. The semantic fuzz target uses the same oracle.

Allocation proof excludes compiler construction and compares 32 with 8,193 preceding native branches under one fixed 128-byte ceiling. A deliberate native block-population copy must fail that contract. Causal faults must fail real assertions, never substitute panics or compile failures. Retain each original failure, focused restored control, race proof, scoped vet/staticcheck, serial 3s benchmark and serial 3s fuzz. Untouched durable writer, ledger, reporter and CLI protocols are not changed by this borrowed internal-flow fact. Independent acceptance and full migration remain open.

Release coordination: preserve other workers, compare owned bytes with the frozen candidate, reread main HEAD and compass/config.json before allocating a version, and stage/commit only owned paths. An unrelated version alone does not justify repeating proof.
